This is a senior-level Product Engineer role at Allstate, working on customer-facing digital insurance products within an agile, pair-programming and test-driven engineering culture. The work centers on designing and building REST APIs and large-scale distributed systems in Java and Spring Boot, with microservices deployed to the cloud. The supporting stack includes MongoDB and caching, Kafka messaging, Maven/Gradle builds, Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, API security standards like OAuth and OpenID, and some Python.
